body:
## Pull request overview

This PR removes the legacy full-page **ViewDesigner** system and consolidates view configuration into the schema-driven **ViewConfigPanel**, adding **undo/redo** and **drag-and-drop column reordering** so there’s a single maintained configuration workflow in the Console.

**Changes:**
- Removed ViewDesigner components, routes, tests, types, exports, and i18n keys associated with the “Advanced Editor”.
- Extended `useConfigDraft` + `ConfigPanelRenderer` to support undo/redo controls and history.
- Added `@dnd-kit`-based drag-to-reorder behavior to the ViewConfigPanel field selector.

`maxHistory` can be configured, but the trimming logic `slice(-(maxHistory - 1))` breaks for `maxHistory <= 1` (e.g., `maxHistory=1` results in `slice(0)` and the history can grow unbounded). Clamp `maxHistory` to a minimum of 2 or handle small values explicitly (e.g., disable undo when `maxHistory < 2`).

Undo/Redo buttons are icon-only but don’t have an accessible name. `title` is not a reliable label for screen readers, so these buttons should include `aria-label` (and ideally also keep `title` for tooltips).

`undo()` / `redo()` update `draft` but never update `isDirty`. After any change, `isDirty` stays `true` even if the user undoes back to the original `source`, so the Save/Discard footer will remain visible and the panel will appear dirty when it isn’t. Consider recomputing `isDirty` after undo/redo (e.g., compare the new draft to the current source, while keeping `mode==='create'` always dirty).

The `forceRender` state is incremented after every `setDraft` call (updateField/undo/redo/discard). Since updating `draft` already triggers a re-render, this causes an extra render per operation and can noticeably impact panel responsiveness. Consider removing `forceRender` and making `canUndo`/`canRedo` trackable without a second render (e.g., store history lengths in state or derive them during the same render driven by `draft`).
